 HONOR Play 20A Debuts on Shopee 11.11 at PHP 45/Day
 By Wazzup.PH - November 10, 2026 0 70 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp 
 Get HONOR’s newest smartphone for PHP 8,099, with exclusive Shopee vouchers, free shipping, and 0% interest installments via SPayLater. 
 Global AI device provider HONOR Philippines is giving Filipino consumers an early chance to get their hands on the HONOR Play 20A , available exclusively on Shopee this November 11 as part of the 11.11 Mega Pamasko Sale .
 Offered at a special price of PHP 8,099 , down from its PHP 8,999 suggested retail price (SRP), the smartphone can also be purchased for as low as PHP 45 per day for six months at 0% interest through SPayLater, making it even more accessible to shoppers.
 Designed to deliver everyday convenience and entertainment, the HONOR Play 20A features an interactive 2-inch Smart Rear Screen that allows users to check notifications, control media playback, and take selfies using the rear camera. It also boasts a 6.9-inch display with a 90Hz refresh rate for smoother viewing, complemented by a 6,000mAh battery built to support daily use.
 “We want to make the HONOR Play 20A more accessible to Filipino consumers while giving them more ways to enjoy its features,” said Stephen Cheng, Vice President of HONOR Philippines. “Through our exclusive Shopee availability this 11.11, customers can take advantage of special pricing, vouchers, and flexible payment options, making it easier to experience a smartphone designed for their everyday needs.”
 Get More Deals This 11.11 on Shopee 
 Customers can purchase the HONOR Play 20A for PHP 8,099 , with an additional 20% OFF Mega Discount Voucher and free shipping available on Shopee. For those who prefer installment payments, the device is also available for as low as PHP 45 per day for six months at 0% interest through SPayLater.
 Shoppers can also enjoy exclusive discounts, vouchers, and freebies during Shopee Live sessions featuring James Afante on November 10 at 12 noon and Kris Aquino and Bimby Aquino on November 10 at 6 PM .
 The HONOR Play 20A will be available exclusively on Shopee for early online access on November 11 , ahead of its official launch and nationwide availability on November 28, 2026 .
 For more information about HONOR Philippines, visit https://www.honor.com/ph/ . To stay updated on launch announcements, product details, and exclusive offers, follow HONOR Philippines on Facebook , Instagram , and TikTok .
